settings.label: Use mock PDP data
settings.info: Development only. When ON, product-page fields that are empty in Shopify are filled from snippets/agha-pdp-mock-data.liquid. Real Shopify data always wins. Turn OFF before going live; the page then shows real data only and hides empty fields.

settings.label: Wishlist storage
settings.info: Shopify has no built-in wishlist storage for classic customer accounts. "App proxy" talks to the endpoint below (a wishlist app or a small custom app). "This browser only" is a development stand-in and does NOT sync across devices.

settings.label: App proxy path
settings.info: The storefront path of your app proxy, e.g. /apps/wishlist. See the wishlist contract in assets/agha-wishlist.js.
